documents.title: Q3 forecast SEK 0.92B below budget — Gripen E/F acceptance milestones slip into 2027
documents.source_ref: SDP Revenue Planning — hours burned × revenue per hour, by programme
documents.excerpt: The Q3 forecast lands at SEK 28.95B against a SEK 29.87B budget (−3.1%). Gripen E/F is SEK 617M behind as acceptance milestones move into 2027; T-7 (−SEK 107M) and Special Mission Platforms (−SEK 92M) follow. Gripen C/D & Support is close to plan (−SEK 29M).

documents.title: Supplier inflation 4 points above contract indexation — Gripen E/F margin drifts 0.8pt
documents.source_ref: SDP Programme Margin — estimate at completion vs contract price
documents.excerpt: Purchased components and subcontract work packages are running about 7% above last year while serial contracts index at about 3%. On the Gripen E/F estimate at completion that is a 0.8 percentage-point gross-margin drift, about SEK 240M in FY2026 before mitigation.

documents.title: SEK/USD at 0.095 — hedge book covers 78% of FY2026 USD purchases
documents.source_ref: SDP Cost Drivers — FX exposure on engines and avionics
documents.excerpt: About a third of materials are bought in USD (engines, avionics). The hedge book covers 78% of FY2026 exposure; a 5% weaker krona on the open 22% costs about SEK 95M of gross profit.

documents.title: Engineering hours, not demand, cap FY2027 revenue — 310 FTE gap at Linköping
documents.source_ref: SDP Engineering Capacity — hours demand from the S&OP plan vs available hours
documents.excerpt: The rate ramp-up needs about 9% more engineering and production hours in FY2027. At current hiring pace Linköping is about 310 FTE short from Q2 2027, which would hold back about SEK 1.1B of revenue.
dimensions: Saab Aeronáutica Montagens (São Bernardo do Campo)

documents.title: Supply-chain delays would cost SEK 1.8B revenue and SEK 1.17B EBIT in FY2026
documents.source_ref: SDP Scenario Analysis — production rate × escalation × learning curve × supplier inflation
documents.excerpt: A supply-chain delay scenario (hours −6%, learning curve +0.5%, supplier inflation +7%) takes FY2026 net sales from SEK 29.87B to SEK 28.07B and EBIT from SEK 1.67B to SEK 0.51B (1.8% margin), because most programme overhead and OpEx is fixed while hours fall.
